_readme: Edit this file to add or remove items. See README.md for field definitions. Every entry needs a title and either a 'file' (path in this repo) or a 'url' (external link). Campaign items also need 'agent' (the owning agent, or Corporate for brokerage wide material) and 'type' (strategy, report, or creative). A 'creative' item points at the self contained ad preview in assets/campaigns, a single file with every image embedded, so it downloads and opens on its own exactly as a strategy PDF does. Copy follows guidelines/brand-voice.md: no em or en dashes, numbers spelled out in prose, facts over superlatives, no commands.
